faqs.a: It is a modern form of accounting that enables remote access to all your company’s financial data. With VAVICOM’s proprietary platform, you have 24/7 document previews, rapid information flow, and real-time data integration between you and the accounting office—regardless of location.

System integration consolidates key company operations (invoicing, payments, warehouse management) in one place. Once the accounting data (costs, payroll) is added, one click provides a comprehensive overview of the business.

faqs.q: How much time can be saved with online accounting?
faqs.a: Online accounting eliminates the need for frequent office visits and speeds up information flow. Both smaller and larger businesses can save a lot of time this way and continually monitor the correctness of data entry.

faqs.q: What does data access look like in online accounting?
faqs.a: It is available 24/7. You can generate reports, graphs, and summaries from anywhere in the world, and also monitor inventory levels and the contractor database in real time.

faqs.q: Why outsource accounting to external accounting offices?
faqs.a: You save on purchasing financial-accounting systems, hiring and training accountants, and maintaining workstations. At the same time, you can be sure that your finances are handled by a team with up-to-date tax regulation expertise.

faqs.q: Can I change accounting offices mid-year?
faqs.a: Yes, anytime—though it’s most convenient at the start of a new fiscal period. Mid-year changes require clarifying responsibility for previous accounting entries and tax settlements.

faqs.q: Is it too time-consuming for you to follow rapidly changing regulations?
faqs.a: An accounting office tracks all changes in tax law and ensures their proper implementation, leaving you free to focus on growing your business.

faqs.q: Are you worried about mistakes in do-it-yourself accounting?
faqs.a: Accounting office specialists minimize the risk of costly errors. This way, your settlements are always compliant with current regulations.

faqs.q: Concerned that documents might get lost?
faqs.a: VAVICOM provides a modern online platform where all invoices and documents are archived in one place. You can easily check what has already been submitted and when.

faqs.q: Do you have bad experiences with accounting offices?
faqs.a: We focus on partnerships with our clients, active consulting, and a stable team of specialists. We care about long-term cooperation based on trust.

faqs.q: No one to consult your current financial and accounting decisions with?
faqs.a: VAVICOM is your business partner — we regularly inform you about legal changes and support you in financial decisions.
It is a combination of traditional service with modern online solutions. You maintain direct contact with a specialist while enjoying the benefits of internet-based document and data access.

faqs.q: In what form do you provide documents to the office?
faqs.a: Electronically is most convenient — for example, via an app, email, or online platform. If you prefer, you can also deliver them in person or by courier.

faqs.q: Is comprehensiveness, professionalism, and timeliness important to you?
faqs.a: At VAVICOM, we provide full confidentiality, data security, and on-time execution of all entrusted matters. This is to ensure you feel confident and can focus on your business.

faqs.q: Are my data secure and can I count on complete discretion in our cooperation?
faqs.a: PRIVACY POLICY Vavicom Accounting Office. Administrator: The data controller is VAVICOM sp. z o.o. based in Piaseczno. Contact details: You can contact the Controller by: email: info@vavicom.pl phone: +48 606 368 694 mail: ul. Grochowskiego 7 lok.25, 05-500 Piaseczno The Administrator has appointed a Data Protection Officer, who can be contacted on all matters related to personal data protection and the exercise of rights held by individuals at iod@vavicom.pl Purpose of processing and legal basis for personal data processing Email and traditional mail communication: art. 6(1)(f) GDPR The legal basis is the Controller’s legitimate interest in conducting correspondence. Telephone contact: art. 6(1)(f) GDPR The legal basis is the Controller’s legitimate interest in addressing issues related to the activity. Recruitment: art. 6(1)(c) GDPR The legal basis is a legal obligation incumbent on the Controller under the Labor Code, and art. 6(1)(a) GDPR The legal basis is consent for data not required by law and for future recruitment processes. Service provision: art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and art. 10(2) of the Act of July 18, 2002 on electronic service provision. The legal basis is expressed consent. Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR The legal basis is contract performance. Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR The legal basis is the Controller’s legitimate interest in, in particular, contract performance and own service marketing. Data collection in business contacts: art. 6(1)(a) GDPR The legal basis is expressed consent. Keeping accounting records and tax documentation: art. 6(1)(c) GDPR in connection with art. 74(2) of the Accounting Act of September 29, 1994. The legal basis is a legal obligation on the Controller arising from the Accounting Act. Communication with persons responsible for contract performance on the business partner’s side: art. 6(1)(f) GDPR The legal basis is the Controller’s legitimate interest in communication with business partners. Data recipients: entities providing specified services, including IT service providers, postal operators, courier companies. Legal and consulting service providers and those supporting the Controller in claiming due receivables, especially law offices. Authorities entitled to receive personal data under the law. Rights of the data subject: The right of access to personal data and the right to request rectification, erasure, or restriction of processing. The right to object to the processing of personal data. The right to withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out on the basis of consent before its withdrawal. To the extent that data are processed for the purpose of concluding and performing a service contract or based on your consent, you also have the right to data portability. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office. Data retention period: Your personal data will be stored until the task for which they were collected is completed and then, for archival materials, for the period resulting from the Act of July 14, 1983 on the national archival resource and archives. In the case of data processed for keeping accounting records and tax documentation, data will be stored for 5 years from the end of the calendar year in which the tax liability arose. For data processed for trust services referred to in art. 17(2) of the Act of September 5, 2016 on trust services and electronic identification, data will be stored for the legally required period of 20 years. For data processed for current and future recruitment processes, data will be stored for 12 months. For data processed for the purpose of pursuing claims, data will be stored for the limitation period provided by law. If you have given consent for your data to be processed for marketing purposes, the data will be stored until you withdraw your consent.

productsContent.title: Accounting
content: Complex and constantly changing business law, including financial reporting and tax regulations, requires continuous monitoring and correct legal interpretation.
By outsourcing the ongoing bookkeeping and financial reporting, you can stop focusing on tracking regulatory changes and devote yourself fully to daily business operations.
Our services include:
keeping the revenue and expense ledger (KPIR)
keeping commercial books
preparing or updating the accounting policy in cooperation with the Client
setting up the data base in a financial-accounting system
recording documents received for your business and its contractors
ongoing bookkeeping
reporting financial data to the company’s management and group in line with your requirements
preparing statutory financial statements and assisting in the preparation of management reports

Our priority is to guarantee on-time accounting services for our clients, always maintaining the highest quality standards. We tailor the accounting and reporting services to specific expectations both formally and substantively, including statutory deadlines and client-imposed time frames.

We provide comprehensive services to business entities, especially micro, small, and medium enterprises. Our primary goal is to fulfill the taxpayer’s ongoing obligations regarding bookkeeping and tax reporting.
We offer competitive prices:
Income records for lump-sum tax from 200 PLN
Revenue and expense ledger (KPIR) from 250 PLN
Accounting (commercial books) from 400 PLN

productsContent.title: HR and payroll
content: We provide comprehensive services for payroll calculation in compliance with labor law, social insurance, and personal income tax regulations.

We also ensure correct, legally compliant administration of employee personal files and all documentation related to employment relationships and leave. We prepare ZUS, PFRON, and tax office returns. We cooperate with these institutions regarding prepared documentation whenever questions arise.
Our services also cover assistance in hiring new employees and offboarding. We make sure that your HR and payroll processes comply with the regulations, are effective, and are easy to manage.
Our HR and payroll services include, among others:
calculating salaries including bonuses and deductions
calculating benefits related to illness and maternity
preparing PIT and ZUS declarations on behalf of the employer
preparing payroll documentation for the company and its employees
assistance with salary payments and social insurance contributions
preparing and submitting annual income statements/declarations (PIT-11, PIT-4R, PIT-40)
creating and maintaining employee personal files
recording and monitoring employees’ leave entitlement
tracking the validity of medical examinations and OHS training
preparing employment certificates
preparing and settling payroll for those employed under civil-law contracts
preparing statements of income from other sources (PIT-28, PIT-8C)

Our offer provides solutions that account for the specific organizational structure of your company, the complexity of payroll components, and HR-payroll reporting. We respond quickly and adjust to your needs and requirements. We guarantee complete confidentiality and data security for HR-payroll records and restructuring projects. We help reduce HR management costs.
We offer our broad range of services to any employer who hires employees, regardless of company size. We also help sole proprietors who are self-employed.
We offer competitive prices:
Payroll services from 45 PLN
HR services from 35 PLN per employee

productsContent.title: Accounting and tax settlements
content: The Polish tax system generally imposes a recurring obligation to pay taxes.

This requires regular calculation of tax liabilities and preparing many tax returns and statements for the tax authorities, each with specific deadlines. The VAVICOM Accounting Office provides services in preparing all required tax returns and supports communication with tax authorities, including handling tax inspections.
Our work on CIT settlements includes the complete preparation of periodic calculations and the annual CIT-8 return. In particular, these services include:
periodic and annual CIT calculations with detailed information
preparation and filing of the annual CIT-8 tax return and attachments based on periodic CIT calculations
determination of the amount of tax due, which the company must remit to the tax office before the statutory deadline
VAT settlements include preparing registers and VAT returns, specifically:
creating VAT purchase and sales registers based on submitted documentation
providing classification suggestions for transactions that may affect tax liabilities (costs of revenue generation)
preparing VAT returns based on VAT registers
notifying about the amount of VAT tax liability due
preparing VAT-EU returns — summary information on intra-Community purchase and sales transactions, as well as corrections of VAT-EU returns
preparing monthly Intrastat returns (if required)
indicating potential VAT refund amounts on the VAT return and preparing refund requests if needed

productsContent.title: Financial services
content: Managing corporate finances is a necessary part of everyday tasks for owners and managers.

The VAVICOM Accounting Office has a team of specialists with many years of experience in financial management, strategic consulting, and optimization of business processes and costs. As part of implementation, our experts will design a reporting system tailored to each Client’s needs.
We offer:
Business plans and financial models
Managerial accounting
Cost analysis and optimization
Receivables monitoring and collection
Building controlling systems
Analysis of financing costs including leasing costs
Support in cooperation with banks and financing or insurance institutions

We prepare business plans and financial models to evaluate the effectiveness of investment projects and to prepare documents needed to secure funding. We design managerial accounting and financial analysis systems — reporting solutions individually tailored to each Client’s needs.
We analyze the company’s results and propose alternative solutions to increase profitability/efficiency of business activities.

Effective debt collection does not have to end in litigation or losing a client. Our team offers receivables monitoring and recovery at a very early stage. If such measures do not yield the desired result, we conduct comprehensive court and enforcement proceedings.

productsContent.title: Business services
content: Every business manager needs expert knowledge of ever-changing regulations and how to respond to them properly.
Our business advisory team supports our clients with:
Taking advantage of anti-crisis packages and grants
Changing employment contracts
Maintaining and improving financial liquidity
Developing and implementing crisis management plans
Renegotiating contracts with suppliers and partners
Restructuring
Digitizing and automating business operations
Implementing broadly understood operational and tax solutions helps businesses survive during crises and gain a competitive edge afterwards.
We develop solutions that ensure a company’s financial liquidity, including in the area of public-law obligations, debt collection, and analyzing client solvency.

We can examine contracts with contractors, identify possible renegotiation options. Due to the epidemiological situation, it is permissible to take steps aimed at changing or renegotiating signed contracts, especially regarding modification of remuneration and payment conditions or withdrawing from the contract.

When the only way to avoid losing financial liquidity is to conduct restructuring proceedings, we stand ready to develop a plan to reduce, defer, or spread out in installments any public-law or contractor liabilities.

Digitization is the implementation of cutting-edge technological and IT solutions, ensuring the highest quality of service to your contractors while optimally utilizing existing resources. It often involves reshaping your current business plan and operating methods, improving both internal and external communication, and significantly speeding up access to information for more accurate and effective process control.

productsContent.title: Other services
content: Digitization is the implementation of cutting-edge technological and IT solutions that ensure the highest quality of service for your contractors while optimally utilizing your resources. It often involves reconfiguring an existing business plan and methods of operation, which improves internal and external communication and greatly accelerates access to information that allows for more precise and effective process control.

Do you need to change your management board or have the shareholders changed? Want to change your fiscal year, reduce share capital, or—on the contrary—your company needs more capital? You do not need to search for specialized law firms.
We offer the following services:
Business registration
Company formation
Business suspension or liquidation of a limited liability company
Registration changes such as changing owners, board members, company headquarters, scope of activity (PKD), etc.
Ownership transformations and changes in legal form
Mergers and acquisitions
Legal assistance — drafting legal documents, resolutions, and contracts

We provide a comprehensive service for establishing capital companies. This service includes drafting the company’s articles so that this important document is tailored to your individual needs, business size, and nature, ensuring a broad sense of security and protection of your interests.

During the process, we prepare, file, and track applications in court, the tax office, and the statistical office. We support the introduction of corporate changes, such as changes in board members or changes to the company statute.

We help fulfill formal obligations associated with closing a company’s financial year, including approving financial statements by the shareholders’ meeting, submitting financial statements to the tax office, and filing the financial statements with the commercial court.
